reviews.review:
Almost every aspect of this game is lacklustre, with a few exceptions.
I can only say I've truly enjoyed the game's single-player mode, which was extremely short, lasting around 9 hours from start to finish. The story and characters were relatively uninteresting, (even by Warhammer standards) however the game had much better and more consistent mechanics in the singleplayer than it had in its multiplayer and co-op modes. Enemies in the campaign were at least scaled reasonably, and there were a few interesting set pieces at points that were fun to play through.
This is probably the most horribly balanced non-F2P game I've ever played. The multiplayer is built with a rock-paper-scissors type system in mind, however, instead of rocks, papers, or scissors, all classes and weapons are instead nuclear ICBMs, leading to almost every weapon seemingly killing you instantly. Also, the game sports a totally-not-copied-from-CoD leveling system, where you become stronger than other players because you played longer and therefore have better perks to one-shot them with.
Exterminatus (the co-op mode) is really good at first, especially with friends, however it quickly becomes old after continued playing, and is plagued by many of the same problems the rest of the game is, such as various porting issues, and what may be the worst netcode ever made, even by console standards.
The difficulty scales schizophrenically. One moment you'll be gunning down hordes of weak ork Slugga Boyz, the next you'll be lying dead, surrounded by 3 huge nobs and 20 scar boyz, each scar boy having about 3 times more total health than you do. It gets to the point where the enemies get tough it will be literally impossible to beat them unless you have a very well coordinated team, and a specific cookie-cutter loadout for your squad.
Overall this game is pretty ♥♥♥♥♥♥, except for the singleplayer and the armour customization.
Oh, and most of the DLC is overpriced ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥. 10 dollars for 3 ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ maps? Are you kidding me? THQ can go ♥♥♥♥ themselves with a rake.
This game is a lot of fun offline/online.

Singleplayer of this beautifully made game is a strong story driven and not to mention action packed game. You will be ahving tons of fun with all sorts of weaponry, rangeing from the jet pack aerial assault with your trusted chainsword or poweraxe, but it's even more fun with a big kickass thunderhammer! but the arsenal expands, you can go sniping with the stalker bolter, or why the heck not do some overkill with the LASCANON!?
Then again you might want to stand still and show them orks whos a REAL BOSS by gutting them to nothingness with a good old fashioned Heavy Bolter.
You want a slaughterfeast? this is YOUR GAME!

As for multiplayer it offers some intensive gameplay with your friends, as you progress in levels you unlock not only weapons and stuff but also loadoutslots so you can easier prepre your entry to the game. Aside from that you do gain some nifty perks and the more you use your favourite gun or melee weapon, the better you will be. Get kills and unlock cool stuff!
Bom.. Pena que aqui o lag é grande, talvez pela distância dos servidores..
